title: What If You Were Stuck in a Bunker With Your Crush?
tags: what if you were stuck in a bunker with your crush
stuck in a bunker with your crush
description:
What if you got stuck in a bunker with your crush? Not for an hour. For three months. With no signal, one bucket, and nowhere to go when it gets awkward.

A volcano goes off two hundred miles away, the whole school runs, and you're the only one who knows about the old bunker under the park. You've spoken to Ivy Marsh four times. Two of them were "sorry".

Ninety days. A fan you turn by hand, a water filter called Dennis, a toilet behind a shower curtain with ducks on it, and a sign you painted when you were twelve: KEEP OUT. NO GIRLS.

title: What If You Were Born as Kratos? | God of War
description:
You're a baby in Sparta. In a few decades, you'll kill the god of war, your own father and pretty much all of Olympus. This is the whole life of Kratos — from the Agoge to Valhalla — told as if it were yours.

Ares, the Blades of Chaos, the Ghost of Sparta, Deimos, Zeus, the fall of Olympus, Faye, Atreus, Mimir, Ragnarök and, finally, a god of hope.

Would you still make that deal with Ares? And which game character should be born next? Tell me in the comments.

title: What IF You Had Infinite Money?
description:
What if you had infinite money? 💸 You check your bank account and realise you can buy anything—and your balance never goes down. Your dream house, a private island, even a fleet of supercars are suddenly within reach. But what happens after you’ve bought everything you ever wanted?

In this animated what-if scenario, we imagine life with unlimited money: going on impossible shopping sprees, surprising strangers, and discovering how people treat you when they know you can afford anything. From everyday luxuries to purchases that could change entire cities, how far would you go?

Would you keep your fortune secret or let the whole world know? You could fund scientific discoveries, help millions of people, or turn your wildest ideas into reality. But with endless requests, new friendships, and everyone wanting a piece of your wealth, who could you trust?

This unlimited-money adventure explores what happens when price stops being a limit—and whether having everything you can buy would give you everything you want.

If you enjoyed this adventure, watch our other videos:
⚡ What If You Had Superpowers?
👁️ What If You Could See 10 Seconds Into the Future?

title: If The Whole Theater Laughs At The Wrong Part... DO NOT LAUGH
description:
If the whole theater ever laughs at the wrong part... don't laugh. Don't smile. Don't look at the people sitting beside you. And whatever you do, don't laugh if your friend starts laughing. There are 7 rules. Most people break the third one.

This is an analog horror survival guide for the night an entire theater laughs at a crying little girl: the smiles that stay stretched after the laughter stops, the man behind you who only laughs when you look away, the faces that never blink, your friend's laugh that won't stop, the back row that has been sitting there for decades, the exit that leads straight back to your seat, the usher whose smile doesn't reach his eyes, and the photo your friend sends you the next morning.

FILE 076 - THEATER. Issued by the  Department of Domestic Entities. Please listen to all steps.

CHAPTERS
0:00 If the whole theaters laughs at the wrong part
1:11 Rule 1: Do not laugh with them
2:16 Rule 2: Do not look at the people beside you
3:16 Rule 3: If your friend starts laughing, do not laugh back
4:27 Rule 4: If everyone turns toward you , stay still
5:34 Rule 5: Do not leave before the movie ends
6:46 Rule 6: If the usher approaches you, do not smile
7:50 Rule 7: Leave right now
9:27 The next morning

ABOUT THESE FILES
Every file is one ordinary thing that stops acting ordinary, and the short list of rules that gets you to morning. No explanations. Just instructions.

Yes, it's fiction. The Department does not exist. Laughing at the wrong part of a movie is actually normal: nervous laughter is one of the ways people react to tension or safness. Everything else in the file is made up. All animation, music and sound effects are original.

title: What IF You Were the ONLY GUY at a Girls Only School?
description:
What if you were the ONLY GUY at a girls-only school? 🎒 You walk into your new classroom, and every conversation stops. A registration mix-up has made you the school’s first and only male student—and everyone already knows your name. Could you get through your first day without becoming the centre of attention?

In this animated what-if scenario, we imagine navigating unfamiliar friendships, awkward introductions, and rumours that spread faster than you can explain yourself. From choosing where to sit at lunch to finding a partner for a class project, ordinary school moments suddenly feel much more complicated.

Would you try to blend in or embrace being the new kid everyone’s curious about? Some classmates might welcome you, others might want their space, and plenty would simply want to get on with their day. Could you find your people without letting everyone’s expectations decide who you become?

This school adventure explores friendship, fitting in, and what happens when you stand out before anyone gets to know you. Would being the only guy make school feel completely different—or would homework, exams, and finding a lunch table still be your biggest concerns?

If you enjoyed this adventure, watch our other videos:

title: What If You Aged Backwards?
description:
You're born with a white beard, round glasses and the knees of an eighty-year-old. And every birthday, you blow out the candles and get one year younger.

Your body loses a year. Your brain grows up like everyone else's, and keeps every single memory. At seven, you look seventy-three. At sixteen, strangers give you their seat on the bus. At forty, for one year, you finally look your age. And at seventy, you have the body of a ten-year-old, with forty-six years on the fire department.

Then your old school catches fire, and a kid is trapped behind a gap only a child can fit through.

Watch for the green REAL stamps: the immortal jellyfish that turns back into a baby, and the four genes that make grown-up cells young again.

So, would you want to age backwards? Or is it way too weird? Tell us in the comments.

title: What if You’re The Last Guy on Earth?
tags: what if you were the last man on earth
description:
What if every man on Earth disappeared overnight… except you?

Four billion women. One ordinary guy. And suddenly, humanity’s future depends on him.

In this animated what-if story, an ordinary night turns into global chaos, unexpected fame, and the hardest job in human history. Being the last man on Earth might sound like a dream—but reality gets complicated fast.

Could one man help humanity survive? And what would his life actually look like?

What would YOU do first? Tell us in the comments.

title: ¿Qué pasaría si los humanos nunca hubieran inventado la ropa?
tags: que pasaria si no existiera la ropa
y si los humanos nunca hubieran inventado la ropa
what if humans never invented clothes
description:
Te despiertas, abres el armario… y no hay nada. Ni siquiera calcetines. 🧦
En este mundo los humanos nunca inventaron la ropa: ciudades enteras bajo techos, bares de protector solar, 10.000 paraguas en hora punta y un tal Kevin al que todos llaman «langosta».

Hace unos 170.000 años nuestros antepasados empezaron a usar pieles de animales (lo sabemos gracias al ADN de los piojos). ¿Qué habría pasado si ese momento nunca hubiera llegado? Sin abrigos no hay viajes al frío, sin telares no hay revolución industrial… y sin traje espacial no hay Luna.

title: If Your Sibling Ever Asks What Your Name Is... LIE
description:
If your little sister sits at the end of your bed tonight and asks what your name is, don't tell her. Don't laugh it off, and don't think about it too long. Just lie.

It sounds like a game. It isn't. Something in your house is learning the names of the people who live there, and it only needs to hear yours once. These are the five rules for getting through the night it asks, and the story of a boy named Ethan, who told the truth just once.

Follow the rules. Stay quiet. And whatever you do, don't answer to your real name.

👍 If this one got under your skin, hit Like. It really helps the channel.
🔔 Subscribe and turn on notifications (tap the bell, then All) so you don't miss the next set of rules. New videos every day.
💬 What fake name would you use? Tell us in the comments, but never your real one.
